name: Reducto
one_liner: Agentic document platform to parse, extract, split, classify and edit documents via API, SDKs and MCP.
auth_notes: API key from Studio API Keys, sent as Authorization: Bearer; SDKs read REDUCTO_API_KEY. Keys are shown once and revoked on delete. The OAuth device-code flow applies only to the local MCP and CLI login, not the REST API.
access_notes: Self-serve: sign up at Studio and create an API key. Pages state plans exist (monthly and yearly) but do not give the cost of API usage. The pricing page was not in the cache.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key, documented REST API with parse, extract, split, classify and edit, plus an official MCP server and standard bearer auth. Usage cost is not verified from the cached pages.

identity.quote: Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams.

auth.quote: API keys authenticate your requests to Reducto. Navigate to API Keys in the sidebar to manage them.

access.quote: Sign up at https://studio.reducto.ai/ and create an API key in **API Keys**.

api_surface.quote: Configure webhooks to receive notifications when jobs complete.
SDKs are available for Python and Node.js

mcp.quote: The hosted server runs at https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp.

needs_human_reason: The pricing page (reducto.ai/pricing) was not in the cache, so API cost and plan gating are unverified. Pricing matters for the BUILD_NOW verdict.
